scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
How do you do? I was dispatched from the Main Office.
I'll do my best to not tarnish the reputation of the Guild.
scripts.translation:
[受僱的卡普拉職員]
您好，我是總部派來的職員。
我會努力工作，不辱公會的聲譽。

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
The Contract terms of the hired Kafra Employee are for 1 month and after this term, you will need to pay an additional fee.
It will be useful for our members.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
僱用卡普拉服務人員的合約期限為1個月，到期後需要續繳費用。
這會給公會成員帶來便利。

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
Do you want to visit the room where our valuables are stored?
That room is restricted to you... you are the only one with access to it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
要去存放貴重物品的房間看看嗎？
那裡是您的專屬房間，只有您能進入。

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
If you don't open the treasure box within time limits, there is a possibility of losing it when unexpected situation occurs.
Please make sure to remember that always, Master.
So, for our guild's improvement, you must find time to collect it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
若未能及時開啟寶箱，發生意外時寶箱可能會消失。
主人，請務必牢記這一點。
為了公會的發展，請抽空領取寶箱中的物品。

scripts.text: Go into Master's room.
scripts.translation: 進入會長房間

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
I'll show you the secret path. Follow me...please.
When you want to return here, please press the secret switch.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
我帶您走秘密通道，請跟我來……
想回到這裡時，請按下秘密開關。

scripts.text:
[ Butler {0}]
Goods are produced once a day... if you don't remove them in time, they will not be produced anymore.
Therefore, it will be better if you check up on them from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[管家 {0}]
商品每天生產一次……若不及時領取，就不會繼續生產。
所以最好時常來檢查。

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Those who overcome an ordeal shows a great deal of bravery... and will find their way to another ordeal.'
scripts.translation:
[迴響的聲音]
“通過試煉者已證明自己的勇氣...並將踏上通往下一場試煉的道路。”

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Only the truly brave can take the test.'
scripts.translation:
[迴響的聲音]
“只有真正的勇士才有資格接受試煉。”
